searchText: The fact is that today we have pools delaying over a second block production. So if that's profitable I take it as a sign that we have leeway still. Reorgs exist because of timing games between these players are always testing the limits of what's the latest you can submit your block. I'm not sure if ePBS can handle 12 seconds per slot, but I wouldn't bet against it just yet. In the design you're working on, consider a timely payload that appears to be invalid e.g. exceeding the gas limit. I guess it will be reorged out by EL? But will it be served via req/resp in the network after that? Hi guys, martin and I have an alternative/simpler solution and we made an EIP for that. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8161 Please take a look!
